## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private project data, personal agent memory or generated installers committed.
- [ ] Existing user files and installation were preserved; installer lifecycle checks used an isolated VM/account or are marked pending.
- [ ] Relevant tests were run against this revision; failures and skipped coverage are disclosed above.
- [ ] Shared instructions/knowledge were updated if behavior or workflow changed.
- [ ] No branch protection, test or release gate was bypassed.
